falsification_plan: If TSMC discloses materially looser advanced-packaging utilization, shorter lead times, or clearly non-binding capacity, downgrade the chokepoint thesis.
If major AI customers demonstrate meaningful manufacturing diversification away from TSMC at scale, reduce the control-point rating.
If capex guidance rises but AI-linked backlog or reservation evidence does not tighten, treat the expansion as supply normalization rather than scarcity.
If order visibility, margin mix, or customer commentary show that AI demand is no longer constrained by TSMC capacity, the thesis should be marked as weakened.
next_research_tasks: Check the latest earnings release, investor presentation, and call transcript for AI-related demand commentary, utilization, capex, and advanced-packaging guidance.
Verify whether recent disclosures mention CoWoS or other advanced-packaging expansion pace, backlog, or reservation status.
Cross-check whether hyperscaler and accelerator customers are still signaling supply constraints or are shifting to alternative capacity.
Map any recent customer, facility, or capex disclosures that show where incremental AI capacity is actually being added.
Compare TSMC's AI-linked commentary with ecosystem suppliers to see whether the bottleneck has moved upstream or normalized.
risks: Advanced packaging capacity could expand faster than AI demand, easing the scarcity premium.
Customers could diversify more production away from TSMC if alternative manufacturing or packaging routes become viable.
Export controls, regional demand shifts, or geopolitics could distort bookings and visibility.
If AI demand slows while capex keeps expanding, the bottleneck thesis could weaken.
A strong revenue story is not enough if the constraint is no longer tight; the market may already be pricing the obvious demand exposure.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: AI accelerator design -> leading-edge foundry -> advanced packaging (including CoWoS-class capacity) -> assembly/test -> hyperscaler deployment. TSMC sits at the foundry and advanced-packaging bottleneck layer, where process complexity, customer qualification, and capacity reservation can create scarcity.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: TSMC 仍然是 AI 芯片从设计走向量产的关键关口。随着高端 AI 加速器继续升级，领先制程与先进封装的产能、排产和交付节奏，决定了哪些客户能更快把算力产品真正送上货架。它不是 AI 需求本身，而是 AI 需求能否兑现为出货和收入的核心供给节点。
deep_reports.thesis_en: TSMC remains a key gate from AI chip design to mass production. As high-end AI accelerators continue to upgrade, leading-edge wafer capacity, advanced packaging capacity, scheduling, and delivery cadence determine which customers can actually convert AI demand into shipped products and revenue. It is not the demand engine itself; it is a core supply node that decides whether AI demand can be translated into output.

summary: Layer 5 keeps the AI funnel at the deepest choke-point level and selects only the single strongest follow-on deep-research target. Among the Layer 4 names, TSMC remains the best next-pass target because it sits at the intersection of leading-edge foundry capacity and advanced packaging, which are both essential to AI accelerator scaling and harder to bypass than most downstream AI beneficiaries.
